create_rl_agent: create an Agent instance with a PPOTrainer type and custom training arguments
construct_rl_trainer: construct an RLlib trainer agent from an Agent config and Environment using make_agent
count_trainable_parameters: count the number of trainable parameters in a torch or tf RLlib agent model
get_trainer_config_dict: get the merged RLlib trainer config dictionary with default log level and user args
resolve_trainer_class: resolve a trainer class name string like PPOTrainer to its actual imported class type
